files.author: Robert Ashworth from Bellingham, WA., USA
files.caption: When I stay in a motel.  Not too expensive.  My only motel stops, this trip were Everett, Muckilteo, Richland (pictured here) and Renton.  The rest of the time was camping or staying with people in Pullman and Yakima.
